relation_kinds.translation: proposed translation correspondence; not a certified dictionary sense

editorial_review.scope: All 24 verses reread in both pinned texts.
notes: Gen 22:2–3: emphatic departure and motion construction retained, without separate invented senses.
Gen 22:8,14: provision idiom distinguished from the proper name and its individual source IDs.
Gen 22:12,16–17: refusal and emphatic oath/blessing constructions preserve repeated units.
Gen 22:18: hearing the voice is rendered as obedience, preserving the whole phrase.
Gen 22:20–24: genealogical supplied expressions and individual names retained.
editorial_review.limitations: Both passes performed by the same editor; no independent dictionary-sense verification; publication checks deferred.
